title: On the Robustness of Dialogue History Representation in Conversational Question Answering: A Comprehensive Study and a New Prompt-based Method
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of various history modeling approaches in Conversational Question Answering (CQA) and proposes a new prompt-based method. It does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics beyond general limitations discussions typical in academic papers.
